How to Get a UAE Investor / Partner Visa & Emirates ID Through Company Setup

A comprehensive immigration roadmap for international investors on securing a 2-year renewable UAE Residence Visa, completing the medical fitness test, biometrics capture, and obtaining your physical Emirates ID.

ADVAQ UAE Immigration Team
8 Min Read · Published July 2026
UAE ICP & GDRFA Visa Guidelines
Investor Visa Setup Highlights
  • •2-Year Validity: Issued directly through your Freezone or Mainland company trade license.
  • •3-5 Days Physical Stay: Requires a brief visit to Dubai for medical fitness testing and biometrics.
  • •Emirates ID Utility: Unlocks personal bank accounts, local vehicle leasing, long-term apartment rentals, and tax residency certificates.
  • •180-Day Rule: Keep visa active by entering the UAE at least once every 6 months.

1. What Is a UAE Investor / Partner Visa?

A UAE Investor Visa (or Partner Visa) is a 2-year renewable residence permit granted to foreign shareholders and business owners who register a company in the UAE.

It grants official UAE residency status, tax residence eligibility, and access to the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) Emirates ID system.

2. Step-by-Step Visa & Emirates ID Timeline

  1. Company License Issuance: Obtain your Freezone or Mainland E-License.
  2. Establishment Card (Immigration Card): Issued in 24-48 hours.
  3. Entry Permit Application: Electronic e-visa issued while outside or inside the UAE.
  4. Status Change: In-country status modification (no exit required).
  5. Medical Fitness & Biometrics: Visit Dubai medical center and ICP fingerprint center.
  6. Emirates ID Issuance: Digital Emirates ID issued in 24h; physical card delivered via courier.

3. Medical Fitness Testing & Biometrics Appointment

The mandatory medical test includes a blood screening (HIV, Hepatitis B/C, Syphilis) and a chest X-ray for tuberculosis. VIP processing centers (such as Smart Salem) deliver certified medical results within 30 minutes.

4. Key Benefits of Holding a UAE Emirates ID

  • Open personal & corporate multi-currency bank accounts (AED, USD, EUR, GBP).
  • Lease residential apartments with Ejari contracts.
  • Obtain a UAE driver's license and vehicle registration.
  • Apply for Tax Residency Certificates to prevent home country double taxation.

5. Sponsoring Family Members (Spouse & Children)

As a valid investor visa holder, you can sponsor your spouse and children for 2-year residence visas by presenting your attested marriage certificate, birth certificates, andEjari lease or company office lease.
